item.title: Which Manager Should Follow You Into 2027?

item.description: Before 2027, appraise your managers. Learn which ones to train, which to let go and which to hold close, with a practical guide for Nigerian businesses.

item.title: What Does It Mean to Be a Good Boss?
item.dc:creator: Traction Outsourcing Limited
item.description: Should a good boss be a friend or keep a distance? The six roles every good boss plays, and how employers can grow into them.

item.title: Your Manager Is In Love With Your Staff: How To Manage Romantic Relationships In Your Business
item.dc:creator: Traction Outsourcing Limited

item.title: Traction Outsourcing HRMS Is Now on the Web: Manage Your Staff From Anywhere, on Any Device

item.title: When Will You Fire That Staff?

item.dc:creator: Traction Outsourcing Limited

item.title: A Book That Gets Under Your Skin, in a Good Way

item.title: When the CEO Is the Weak Link

item.title: Excellence or Perfection: Driving Your Team to Produce Results

item.title: Why Nigerian Businesses Are Outsourcing Their HR Entirely
